en.followup_reply: A business or creator account is better, because it shows insights about who sees your posts and lets you add a contact button.

en.memory_turn: I just assembled an IKEA bookshelf, and it took me 4 hours, which wasn't too bad. Now I'm choosing a coffee table. Would a glass top scratch more easily than wood?
en.assistant_reply: Glass resists scratches better than most wood finishes, but it shows fingerprints, dust and water marks quickly. Wood hides daily marks well, though it can dent and needs coasters.
en.followup_turn: Which is easier to keep clean with a cat at home?
en.followup_reply: Wood is usually easier, since paw prints and hair are less visible. A matte or textured finish hides marks best.

en.memory_turn: My internet has been really good lately, especially when streaming on Netflix. I upgraded my plan to 500 Mbps about three weeks ago. But my laptop battery drains fast. Could the battery just be old?
en.assistant_reply: It could be. Batteries lose capacity after a few hundred charge cycles. Check the battery health report in your system settings; if it shows less than about 80 percent of the original capacity, a replacement will help.
en.followup_turn: Can I do anything to make the current battery last longer?
en.followup_reply: Lower the screen brightness, close background apps, and avoid keeping it at full charge all the time. Many laptops have a setting that stops charging at around 80 percent.

en.q2: How fast is the internet plan I upgraded to?
